value.deck: The MSSQL extension for VS Code now includes a SQL Formatter in public preview, helping developers automatically format T-SQL queries and scripts to consistent style guidelines.
shortVersion: The MSSQL extension for VS Code now includes a SQL Formatter in public preview, helping developers automatically format T-SQL queries and scripts to consistent style guidelines.
An integrated SQL formatter in the VS Code MSSQL extension removes the need for external tools and makes T-SQL development faster and more consistent across teams.
